text: Parents show love for their children by spanking them whenever they do wrong. Later those parents will be glad to see their children grow into fine adults.
If parents correct a child, they will someday boast about how much help that child has been to them.
Parents who give their children an education make their enemies jealous and can boast to friends. *
These parents have no regrets when they die, and they live on in their children,
who brought them such joy.
Then it is up to the children to take revenge on their parents' enemies, and to be kind to their parents' friends.
If you spoil your children, you will have to put bandages on the wounds they will get, and you will shake with fear every time you hear shouting.
That's why you must correct them, so they will not be as stubborn as unbroken horses. *
If you give children everything they desire and laugh when they sin,
they will end up giving you sadness, terror, and pain.
Don't let them do just anything they want, but correct their mistakes.
Break their stubbornness by whipping them while they are young, or else they will disobey you and bring you deep sorrow.
Take care to discipline them, so they will not disgrace you when they are older.
I would rather be poor, yet healthy and strong, than to be rich and sickly.
To have your health and a good attitude[64] is better than gold and infinite riches.
No amount of money can compare with health or bring happiness deep inside your heart.
Death is better than a life of constant pain and sickness.
If a fine dinner is served, but the guests are too sick to eat, the dinner will go to waste, like food placed on a grave[65]
or like a sacrifice to an idol, which cannot eat or smell. If the Lord punishes people by making them sick,
they can only stare at food and groan like a young man unable to have sex who holds a virgin in his arms.
Don't stay sad for too long or look for reasons to be upset.
Joy and happiness will help you to live longer.
So enjoy life and forget sorrow, because sorrow never helps, and it has destroyed many.
Jealousy and anger will cut your life short, and worrying makes you old before your time.
If you are cheerful at meals, the food you eat will do you more good.
